title: escallonia rubra var. glutinosa
intro: Escallonia rubra var. glutinosa, commonly known as Escallonia, is a flowering plant species native to the Andes mountains in South America. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Escallonia include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The bioactive constituents present in Escallonia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
